implemented_private_api: parseResult: strict single-project QC writer envelope; exactly known Original/Calibration/Rate/INR; missing and invalid values are explicit errors with NaN, not fabricated zero.
selectHistory: exact control/project/current-or-previous batch isolation; strict date/time/positive unique row ID; per-batch date DESC,time DESC,row ID DESC; previous then current concatenation.
pointAtPlotIndex and explicitly named legacyTraceAtCounter: preserve original reverse-index suspicion independently rather than silently changing chronology.
Per-row/type unit evidence: unknown or association-only snapshot cannot become a historical point snapshot. Known declared anonymous/stored-per-point provenance can convert full-precision values.

summarize: count invalid requested-result exclusions explicitly; refuse unknown/mixed historical units; call byte-identical copied Sn100Quality::calculateStatistics for known same-unit values. No thresholds/status/device/SQL API.
expected_test_behavior: Every case is anonymous source-level input/expected assertion. No result below is claimed until the actual future QtCore executable compiles and returns a genuine exit0 with 20 cases and zero failed checks.
contract_notes: Original date DESC is retained. time DESC/id DESC is a documented deterministic extension for same-date rows, not a claim that old SQL already ordered by them.
Original last30 sequence-position window is preserved; because each batch is date DESC this must not be called the latest30 chronological records.
Original reverse trace counter starts at N-1 and selects plotOrder[0]. It remains explicit for comparison; future UI correction needs a separate intentional-difference decision.
Signed/scientific numeric text uses an explicit finite parser rather than legacy '-' token splitting; unsupported/ambiguous result envelopes fail closed.
Both the existing statistics CLI and this reused helper expose signed CV ratio, not percent. Mean/SD/CV availability flags matter for single-point/near-zero mean cases.
The pure value API assumes the caller supplies rows and unit evidence from one verified dataset. It does not authenticate SQL/catalog UUID or real-world unit provenance.
